notes.title: 🔶🍎 Apple Update 🍏🔶
notes.notes:
🔶 As-Salaam Aleikum! 🔶

We're excited to announce that Zellige: The Tilemaker of Granada is now available on MacOS!

We wanted to make sure as many people as possible could play our game, so this was the next logical step!

We've also added a few quality of life improvements, notably to the catalogue and the knife / erasing tool, along with a few bug fixes.

Read on for the full list:


 MacOS version now available to download
 Improved catalogue performance and feel
 Added click and drag functionality to the knife: The lines crossed by your slash will be erased.
 Player character no longer drifts forward when player releases "Forward" key
 Fixed palace completion achievement
 Fixed typo in localization table


And that's about it, but we've got some more more exciting news coming soon, so be sure to keep an eye out!

Also, thank you for posting about any bugs you see in the Steam forums, we're taking note and integrating them into our roadmap as we move forward!

Until next time, we hope you have fun making tiles and relaxing in the sun!

🔷 Ma'a salama! 🔷

notes.title: Revert on latest update
notes.notes: Oops! Sorry about that, we have to temporaririly revert our latest update! A game-breaking infinite loop snuck into our achievement changes, we're working to fix it now.

notes.title: 🔶🌷 Nowruz Update 🌹🔶
notes.notes:
🔶 As-Salaam Aleikum! 🔶

In this time of celebration, we want to wish a belated Nowruz Mubarak to our Persian friends, and Ramadan Kareem to all who celebrate it!

We've been busy making improvements to the game, but foremost among them is a translation into Farsi!
We knew we wanted to do this for a long time, so we're happy it's finally in.

Also, we added a button to cleanly exit the design interface! You'll find it in the shape of a little cross in the top right corner of the design screen. It'll bring up a "confirm" option screen to make sure you dont accidentally lose your work.

Other improvements and bug fixes include:


 The Blooms of the Zawiya and the Lost Patterns of the Madrasa should now have working templates and instructions
 Rooms will check for the room completion achievement whenever a mosaic is completed, instead of when you get to the end of the room completion dialogue
 Invisible wall should no longer appear in the courtyard in some circumstances
 Instructions should no longer pollute an imported mosaic
 Can no longer accidentally take a picture of Abu Dhahban (but we'll look into maybe putting it back in a more formal manner, no promises though!)
 Can no longer leave the design interface during the finalization process, which caused the interface to stay on screen
 A few UI tweaks to improve readability in all languages
 Made the diary entries stay on screen longer when starting a new day, people were (rightfully!) complaining that they went by too quickly to read


And that's all for now, though there's still a few bits and pieces we want to fix going forward.
We're noting any bugs you bring up in the Steam forums, so we'll be back with fixes again in the future!

Until then, we hope you have a good springtime and an excellent month by the light of the moon!

🔷 Ma'a salama! 🔷
